$comment: The B-Gem palette. SEMANTICS ONLY — no hex values live here.
The hexes are in css/tokens.css (--color-ruby and siblings) and are
joined onto this map by scripts/generate.mjs. That is deliberate: a
colour typed in two files is a colour that will eventually differ in
two files, which is the exact failure this package was extracted to
end. Read dist/tokens.json for the joined result.
⚠️ THIS IS A MEDIA-TYPE MAP, NOT A SITE PALETTE. A gem MEANS a medium:
amethyst means 'this artifact is a letter'. Using a gem as a site
accent is only correct where the gem IS that product's medium.
⚠️ AND IT IS NOT THE SIX-TLD RAINBOW. That is a different palette with
a different job (one colour per TLD / product class, the B-Aura
thesis). Seven gems, six rainbow colours, and they must never be
order: The Metta Light descent: session start at ruby, session end at diamond.

gems.name: diamond
gems.note: The unrefracted seventh. A cool near-white, not #FFFFFF, so it reads as luminous rather than flat.

reserved.pink: ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION. Reserved for B-Dating and romantic contexts. It is not an oversight and must not be filled in.

siteValues.name: violet-sey
siteValues.note: NOT an eighth gem. The commons' medium is not one of the seven, so borrowing amethyst would overload a channel the doctrine reserves. The measured reason agrees: those pages are read at arm's length outdoors and the more saturated violet survives sunlight.
